response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The `laps` field, though defined as TEXT, contains numeric values or castable-to-numeric values. Non-numeric entries, if present, will be coerced to NULL by the CAST and excluded from the average.
